# GaitReport

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/gait.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

Measures of the kinematic walk's bodies (GaitChecks): this tick's values and the worst since settle seconds.

## Notes

On the rig entity, emplaced by GaitChecks; GaitRoutes clears is_planted and settle_time at a new route. Read by the IK and GAIT tests, the terrain walker tests and the gait viewer.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: GaitView. Written by: GaitChecks, GaitRoutes. Created by: GaitChecks. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick | emplaced on first use; this tick's measures and the worst since settle |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | start | is_planted and settle_time cleared (when present) |
| [GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (world registry) | checks shown (now / worst) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
